newsitem.title: USA: Mutual Life Insurance of NY target of suit-lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Mutual Life Insurance of NY target of suit-lawyers.

text.p: Attorneys for members of the Eastern Retail Hardware Association who participated in a Mutual Life Insurance Co of New York death and retirement benefits plan said Thursday a class action lawsuit was filed against Mutual Life..
The complaint alleges the defendant designed a plan that from the start was likely to fail and bankrupt the association.
The company declined to comment on the suit.
The complaint alleges the plan depended on assumptions regarding death rates among plan participants and the rates of return earned on life insurance policies.

It also alleges the defendants failed to disclose that if actual rates were lower than estimated, the association would have to pay hundreds of thousands of dollars in annual benefits and additional annual premiums -- which, the complaint alleges, the association never had the ability to pay.
The suit was filed in the Middlesex Superior Court of Massachusetts.
